asr.runtime: same Hugging Face Whisper worker in every mode; requests serialized

hf.plannerLock: one request at a time per process

vllm.prefixCaching: engine default; repeated common prompts and six-command pool can benefit

sharing.plannerInTwoContainers: same Phi model weights copied twice; no memory/compute isolation
sharing.routing: application least-active request count, round-robin ties

interpretation: Practical deployment configurations compared end-to-end. CPU scheduling, GPU contention, cache behavior and engine kernels can all affect results; exact memory-bandwidth bottlenecks were not hardware-profiled.

vllmQwenCandidate.baseConfiguration: same image, BF16, 4096 context, max16 sequences and 0.75 memory pool as Phi; additional --language-model-only
vllmQwenCandidate.note: Qwen is a separate model/configuration candidate; the three-way same-model serving comparison remains Phi only.
